title: After the Satsuki Sho: Next Time for Sure!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon wins, shattering Matikanetannhauser's dream of becoming Triple Crown champion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Optimistic as always, Matikanetannhauser wants to use what she learned from today's race to do better in the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower, who also lost today, is motivated for the future as well, acknowledging that she still has a long way to go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our classic year is far from over, and we're going to keep running toward the Japanese Derby!
